architecture_invariants: Edge-deployed serverless functions with filesystem-based routing — Vercel/Cloudflare-like runtime limits function size, cold-start latency, and execution duration; underscore-prefixed helpers avoid cold-start by sharing modules rather than duplicating across edge functions

Proto-defined service contracts (IDL-first) — API handler stubs, SDK clients, and validation schemas are code-generated from proto definitions, not hand-written; any change to the API surface requires proto modification + regeneration
AGPL-3.0-only license — restricts distribution and derivative works; all external consumption must comply with copyleft terms, influencing SDK client distribution model and third-party integration
Single codebase, multi-brand variant system — all brand sites are built from the same source tree with per-variant configuration and asset overlays; no branches, no forks, no multi-repo

Multi-tier caching with coordinated invalidation — CDN edge cache, Redis cluster, and in-browser bootstrap cache must maintain coherence; cache invalidation signals propagate from Data Aggregation Pipeline through to the browser

Circuit breaker resilience for all external dependencies — every external fetch is wrapped in a breaker with open/half-open/closed states; failure threshold triggers fast-fail or cache fallback instead of cascading failure

challenge_record.target: Token-overlap routing over NLU for agent tool suggestion
challenge_record.challenge: 移除测试: 如果移除 token-overlap，系统需要一个替代路由机制。但现有工具注册表 (tools/list) 和 concierge 结构本质上是简单的名称+描述匹配，任何 keyword-match 实现（包括直接字符串包含或 glob 匹配）都能替换 token-overlap 而不会改变系统行为。移除后系统仍然成立，只是降低了名称优先级的精细度。这暗示 token-overlap 不是架构核心决策，只是一个实现细节，不应作为架构层面的核心结论突出。
evidence: api/_agent-tool-suggest.ts 路由逻辑本质上是名称/描述分词交叠 + 名称加权 — 任何关键词匹配算法都可以替代
工具注册表 tools/list 匿名发布，路由决策完全基于注册表内容，路由算法本身是可替换的实现细节
challenge_record.model_delta: Token-overlap 路由应从核心设计决策降级为实现细节。核心决策是: (1) 基于工具注册表的显式路由，而非意图分类；(2) 工具注册表本身是匿名、可发现的。路由算法（token-overlap vs keyword-match vs regex）是实现选择，不是架构决策。

challenge_record.challenge: 假设翻转: 如果系统没有 proto IDL，我们应该看到什么？(1) API handler 和 SDK 之间类型不匹配的证据；(2) 重复的类型定义分散在 api/ 和 sdk/ 中；(3) 手动更新 SDK 导致的 bug 追踪。但当前证据并不排除这些问题是 proto 解决的，也不排除手写 API 也能通过严格 TypeScript 类型共享 + review 流程达到同等一致性。更关键的是: 证据只提到 'Proto IDL → code generator' 的行为数据流，但没有展示任何实际的 proto 文件路径、代码生成脚本、或生成后的 handler stub 文件。这可能是架构意图（intended architecture）而非已实现架构（implemented architecture）。
evidence: Repository Model 中 proto/ 路径存在，但没有任何 .proto 文件、生成脚本、或 generate 命令的证据
八次 'Proto IDL → code generator → ...' 的描述在 architecture explanation 中出现五次，但全部引用 Repository Model 的同一段描述，没有独立证据链
如果 proto 真正驱动所有 handler，api/ 目录下的 handler 文件应该是生成后的 stub（带 'DO NOT EDIT' 注释），但没有这类证据
challenge_record.model_delta: Proto IDL 从已验证的工程约束降级为架构意图。系统有一个 proto/ 目录和代码生成 pipeline 的计划，但当前 api/ 中的 handler 可能是手写的。核心决策应该是 'IDL-first contract governance' 作为架构目标，而非已实现的约束。需要区分 'intended architecture' 和 'implemented architecture'。

challenge_record.target: No dedicated database (state is ephemeral cache + config)
challenge_record.challenge: 时间测试: 'No database' 在当前规模下是最优的（聚合层+展示层，不拥有数据）。但考虑演化轨迹: 从单数据仪表盘→AI-powered 情报平台→多品牌→Agent-native 平台。每步演化都增加了状态类型: intelligence graph（当前用 AI-powered correlation pipeline 输出，无持久化）、用户偏好/订阅、品牌级 feature flag 历史、agent interaction logs。当系统从 '外部数据源的聚合层' 转向 '拥有自己的分析产物和用户关系的平台' 时，cache-as-primary-storage 模式会达到拐点。拐点标志: (1) 数据丢失导致不可恢复的状态；(2) 数据需要被多个不共享 cache 的服务消费；(3) 查询模式超出 key-value 模型。
evidence: evolution.major_changes 显示系统正从聚合仪表盘转向 AI-powered 平台和 Agent-native 平台 — 每一步都增加持久化需求
current_direction: 'intelligence graph 增强和 Agent ecosystem 扩展' — intelligence graph 天然需要持久化存储
Intelligence dashboard + AI-powered entity extraction + cross-domain correlation 产生的分析结果是高价值、可重用的，cache 过期丢失是浪费
challenge_record.model_delta: 'No database' 是当前阶段正确但有时效性的架构决策。应在 intentional_omissions 中标注 'Temporary: valid while system remains pure aggregation layer; intelligence graph and agent ecosystem evolution will demand persistent storage'。架构需要预留数据库接入点（repository pattern 抽象），避免未来引入数据库时大规模重构。

challenge_record.target: Multi-tier caching (CDN + Redis + Bootstrap) with coordinated invalidation
challenge_record.challenge: 边界测试: 多级缓存在什么条件下不成立？(1) 当 intelligence dashboard 的数据 freshness 要求超过 cache 刷新频率时 — stale intelligence data 比 no data 更危险（过时的态势感知可能导致错误决策）；(2) 三级缓存协调的复杂度随数据源数量线性增长 — 数十个外部源各自有不同的 freshness 需求，协调 invalidation 信号在所有三级缓存间传播的复杂度和延迟可能抵消缓存收益；(3) 'freshness-gated TTL' 模式在某个 TTL 阈值以下不如直接查后端 — 如果大部分数据的 freshness 窗口 < 5秒，缓存只是额外开销。系统没有给出任何 TTL 范围、cache hit ratio 指标、或 freshness SLA。
evidence: architectural_tensions 承认 'Multi-tier cache coherence vs data freshness for intelligence use cases' — stale intelligence data is worse than no data
没有提供任何缓存层性能指标（hit ratio、TTL range、freshness SLA），无法评估 multi-tier 是否实际优于 simpler 策略
数据流描述 '外部数据源 → 聚合管道 → Redis 缓存 → CDN 边缘缓存 → SPA 前端 bootstrap cache' 是五跳数据流，每跳都引入延迟和复杂度
challenge_record.model_delta: Multi-tier caching 从架构优势重新标定为 'tradeoff with context-dependent optimality'。需要补充: (1) per-data-class 缓存策略（高 freshness 要求数据跳过缓存直接走聚合管道）；(2) 缓存收益的量化基准（hit ratio、freshness SLA compliance）；(3) 'coordinated invalidation' 的具体协议（push-based vs pull-based vs TTL-only）。三个层级（CDN→Redis→Bootstrap）的用途需要区分: CDN 适合公开/静态数据，Redis 适合共享服务器状态，Bootstrap 适合 SPA bundle 本身。但 intelligence data 的最佳路径可能是 skip CDN and bootstrap。

challenge_record.target: Automated architecture enforcement via 8+ lint scripts
challenge_record.challenge: 移除测试: 如果移除所有 8 个 lint 脚本，架构会崩塌吗？不会，lint 脚本是 'architecture governance automation'，不是 'architecture itself'。模块边界是代码结构问题，不是 lint 脚本创建的；API 合约是 proto IDL 定义的，不是 lint 验证的。Lint 验证的是合规性而非架构设计。真正架构级的问题是: (1) 如果这些规则被违反，系统在运行时是否出问题？(2) 是否有些规则应该由编译器/类型系统强制执行而非事后 lint？将 lint 提升为架构层决策暗示架构依赖于 lint 的正确性，但实际依赖于代码结构和运行时的正确性。更好的架构视角: lint 是 'CI/CD 质量门禁'，不是架构组件。
evidence: 所有 8 个 lint 脚本的功能是验证（module boundaries、API contract、rate limit policies 等），不是生成或驱动架构
没有证据显示移除 lint 会导致运行时错误 — 违反 module boundary 可能在运行时正常工作但降低可维护性
脚本路径 scripts/ 和独立脚本架构是好的 development practice，但作为 'architecture component' 过度提升
challenge_record.model_delta: Lint & Enforcement 应从架构组件降级为开发实践/CI 质量门禁。它在 Repository Model 中作为一个独立模块出现会在架构层产生误导 — 它不参与运行时、不处理请求、不存储数据。更好表示为 'CI/CD Quality Gates'，关注其 enforce 的 architecture rules 内容而非 enforce 机制本身。

challenge_record.target: A2A protocol + custom concierge over LangChain/Semantic Kernel
challenge_record.challenge: 假设翻转: 如果系统使用了 LangChain 或 Semantic Kernel，我们期望看到什么？(1) LangChain 的 LCEL 声明式 pipeline；(2) 工具调用抽象 (tool calling / function calling 接口)；(3) agent executor 和 agent loop。但当前实现的自定义 concierge 也完成了同样的事情（工具注册表→路由→调用→返回），且更轻量。更有趣的翻转问题是: 如果系统没有实现 A2A 标准而是使用纯 REST API for agents，当前是否足够？现有的 tools/list + token-overlap concierge 本质上是 REST API 之上的一个轻量语义层。如果 agent 直接通过 REST API 调用具体端点（不需要 'discovery → routing → intent matching'），系统已完整运行。A2A 是面向未来的生态系统兼容性投资，不是当前必需的。
evidence: A2A 协议端点和 tools/list 匿名发布确实是新增的 agent 发现能力
但系统原本的 REST API 已经可以为 agent 提供服务（REST endpoints + API key auth），agent 不需要 A2A 也能使用
design_decisions 承认 A2A 是 'emerging open standard'，说明是基于未来生态标准选择而非当前需求
challenge_record.model_delta: A2A 决策 survived 但需重新定位: '超前投资于未来 agent 生态互操作性，当前阶段 REST API 已满足 agent 需求'。需要在 tradeoffs 中补充 'A2A 协议兼容性 vs 当前 REST-only agent 支持的权衡'。核心架构贡献不是 A2A 本身，而是 'agent 接口与人类接口分离为两个平行的 API surface' 的设计哲学。

challenge_record.target: Edge-server binary partition (edge = thin receptor, server = processor core)
challenge_record.challenge: 边界测试: Edge vs server 的二分法模糊发生于: (1) 数据聚合 Pipeline 中 AI-powered correlation 运行在 server，但部分预处理（去重、归一化）如果移到 edge 可以减少 server 负载和延迟 — 随着 edge function 计算能力提升和 WASM 成熟，部分数据管道逻辑会自然迁移到 edge，打破 'edge = thin' 假设；(2) Circuit breaker 状态当前由 server 持有，但断路检测（错误率阈值判断）可以也在 edge 执行以减少 server 调用 — 这导致 'stateless edge' 假设不成立；(3) 工具路由 (_agent-tool-suggest.ts) 当前在 edge，但复杂的多步 agent 任务需要在 edge 和 server 之间协调，edge 无法保持完全无状态。Edge/server 边界不是固定的，应该视为滑动的决策光谱: 每个 capability 独立决定 edge-side vs server-side 分割点，而非一刀切的 'edge = thin, server = fat'。
evidence: system already runs stateful operations at edge: auth middleware checks DESKTOP_ORIGIN_PATTERNS (配置状态), rate limit buckets (计数器状态), cache coordination (缓存状态)
Agent Platform (A2A + concierge) runs at edge and will need context management as agent interactions become multi-step — breaking stateless edge assumption
challenge_record.model_delta: Edge/server 不应该被视为固定的架构二分法，而应该被建模为 capability-dependent deployment spectrum。需要: (1) 每个 capability 标注 deployment profile（edge-only / server-only / split / migrateable）；(2) 承认 'edge keeps growing thicker' 是持续架构压力；(3) 重新表述 maintainer mental model 从 'edge = thin receptor, server = processor core' 到 'edge = time-sensitive operations, server = resource-intensive operations，capability 可在两者间随基础设施演进滑动'。

challenge_record.challenge: 时间测试: 单代码库多品牌初始阶段最优，但考虑演化: 当品牌数量从 2-3 增长到 10+ 时，variant 配置复杂度（品牌 logo、配色、feature flags、独立部署子域）线性增长，但品牌特异功能（brand-specific feature flags 含义不同、不同品牌需要不同的数据源）会导致条件逻辑指数级扩散。每个 'if (brand === X)' 都可能从一行膨胀为一种品牌特异行为。当品牌特异行为超过共享逻辑时，共享代码库从 '统一平台' 退化为 '带配置的多个不兼容应用共存于同一代码空间'。
evidence: architectural_tensions 承认 'Single codebase multi-brand efficiency vs increasing brand-specific divergence over time'
variant 配置包含 feature flags，但 feature flags 没有跨品牌的命名空间隔离 — 不同品牌的同名 flag 含义可能不同
没有证据显示系统有 'abstraction stability' 度量或 'variation encapsulation' 模式（如 plugin system、brand-specific module loading）
challenge_record.model_delta: Single codebase multi-brand 配置从 '已验证的工程约束' 重新标定。需要补充: (1) 品牌特异功能 vs 共享功能的比例监控指标；(2) variant 配置的版本控制和迁移策略（避免 breaking all brands on config change）；(3) '可选的品牌级代码隔离' 机制（允许高品牌特异度的模块从主代码库分离为品牌 plugin）作为演进路径。

challenge_record.target: No vector database or embeddings for intelligence correlation
challenge_record.challenge: 边界测试: 当前 AI-powered 实体提取和事件关联使用 rule-based 方法在什么条件下不足以支持 intelligence 需求？(1) 跨语言实体解析 — 中文新闻中的 '习近平' 和英文的 'Xi Jinping' 需要跨语言实体链接，rule-based 需要维护大量别名映射；(2) 事件关联超出显式关系 — '深圳工厂停电' 和 '富士康 iOS 18 量产延期' 需要隐式语义关联；(3) 雷达/仪表盘的情境感知搜索 — 'show me what happened in South China Sea yesterday' 需要语义理解而非 token-overlap。当 intelligence correlation 从 '已知 entity 的事件关联' 发展到 '新 entity 发现 + 隐式事件因果关系推理' 时，rule-based token-overlap 达到上限。
evidence: intentional_omissions 承认 'rule-based entity extraction' 而非 'semantic/vector similarity'，且 favoring precision over recall
但 current_direction 明确说 'intelligence graph 增强' — intelligence graph 的核心价值是 entity 间隐式关系的发现和推理，这天然需要语义模型
跨语言 intelligence（global intelligence dashboard）需要处理多语言 entity 解析 — rule-based 映射表在每增加一种语言时都需要维护
challenge_record.model_delta: 'No vector DB' 应重新标定为 '目前不需，未来可能需要'。当前阶段的 rule-based 实体提取适合高精度、少语言场景。intelligence graph 演进到跨语言、隐式关系推理时将需要向量/语义模型。架构应在 data aggregation pipeline 中预留 embedding extraction 和 semantic index 的接入点，而不是完全排除。当前 'no vector DB' 不是一个永久性架构决策，是一个阶段性的 'not yet'。

challenge_record.target: Desktop Tauri support via origin allowlisting (shared auth model with web)
challenge_record.challenge: 假设翻转: 如果 desktop 使用了独立的 auth 系统（OS keychain + biometric），与 web 共享的是什么？实际上 web 和 desktop 共享的是 'API Key' 和 'Session Token' — 这意味着 desktop 用户必须知道或拥有一个 API Key，或者通过 web 登录获取 session token 后在 desktop 使用。这是一个 'desktop-as-web-client' 模型而非 'native desktop app' 模型。真正的 native desktop auth 会使用 OS-level credential store、hardware-backed key storage、SSO broker。当前设计暗示 desktop 不是一个独立的安全域，而是 web 的另一个渲染上下文。这种设计选择对 security-sensitive intelligence dashboard 来说是否足够？
evidence: DESKTOP_ORIGIN_PATTERNS allowlist 包含 tauri.localhost, tauri://localhost, asset://localhost — 这些都是 localhost origins
没有 evidence 显示 desktop 端使用了操作系统级安全能力（钥匙串、TPM、生物识别）
共享 auth 模型意味着 desktop session 有效期受 web session token 生命周期约束，desktop 无法在离线时提供任何价值
challenge_record.model_delta: Desktop 支持从 'extension point' 重新评估: 当前 desktop 是 'web app 的 tauri 包装'，与 '原生桌面应用' 有根本差异。架构应区分: (1) Phase 1 — Desktop-as-Web-Client（当前，origin allowlisting + shared auth）；(2) Phase 2 — Desktop-as-Native-App（OS keychain、硬件认证、离线能力）。当前设计仅实现 Phase 1。

design_space.decision: Token-overlap routing over Natural Language Understanding for agent tool suggestion
design_space.chosen: A transparent token-overlap scoring algorithm comparing request tokens against tool names and descriptions; name hits weighted higher than description hits
rejected: NLU-based intent classification (adds latency, cold-start penalty, and model dependency)
Hard-coded route mapping (requires manual updates per new tool)
Vector embedding similarity (over-engineered for current scale)
design_space.why_chosen: Deliberately transparent and debuggable — the concierge routing is a deterministic function of the tool registry and request text, not a black-box model. Name-hit dominance ('chokepoint status' lands on get_chokepoint_status) provides intuitive routing. The approach avoids cold-start overhead of loading an NLU model in edge functions.
design_space.why_rejected: Deliberately transparent and debuggable — the concierge routing is a deterministic function of the tool registry and request text, not a black-box model. Name-hit dominance ('chokepoint status' lands on get_chokepoint_status) provides intuitive routing. The approach avoids cold-start overhead of loading an NLU model in edge functions.
evidence: api/_agent-tool-suggest.ts: 'Deliberately not NLU — a transparent token-overlap score over the same names + descriptions tools/list publishes anonymously. Name hits outweigh description hits so "chokepoint status" lands on get_chokepoint_status, not on every tool whose prose mentions shipping.'

design_space.decision: Proto-defined IDL with code generation over hand-written API handlers and SDKs
design_space.chosen: Service contracts defined in proto IDL → automated code generation produces API handler stubs, SDK client packages, and JSON Schema validators
rejected: Hand-written API handlers (prone to drift between spec and implementation)
OpenAPI/Swagger-first (less strict contract enforcement)
No contract (inconsistent API surface, manual SDK maintenance)
design_space.why_chosen: Ensures API surface and SDK client are always consistent — changing the proto regenerates all artifacts. Reduces human error in cross-boundary type definitions. Enables 'add a service = define proto + regenerate' zero-friction extension model.
design_space.why_rejected: Ensures API surface and SDK client are always consistent — changing the proto regenerates all artifacts. Reduces human error in cross-boundary type definitions. Enables 'add a service = define proto + regenerate' zero-friction extension model.

design_space.decision: Single-codebase multi-brand variant system over multi-repo or branch-per-brand
design_space.chosen: Runtime brand selection via Host header → variant configuration query → brand-specific asset overlay and style rendering from a single codebase
rejected: Separate repositories per brand (duplicate infrastructure, divergent codebases, multiplied maintenance)
Git branches per brand (merge hell, cherry-pick errors, no shared backend)
Feature flags only (insufficient for full brand theming)
design_space.why_chosen: Shared data backend, infrastructure, and code while allowing independent brand identity. Variant deployment to separate subdomains enables independent scaling and deployment cadence per brand. Single codebase guarantees all brands benefit from bug fixes and features.
design_space.why_rejected: Shared data backend, infrastructure, and code while allowing independent brand identity. Variant deployment to separate subdomains enables independent scaling and deployment cadence per brand. Single codebase guarantees all brands benefit from bug fixes and features.

design_space.decision: Filesystem-based routing in edge functions over configuration-based routing
design_space.chosen: Edge function runtime resolves routes by directory structure: concrete handlers > nested dynamic gateways (api/<service>/v1/[rpc].ts) > versioned gateways (api/v2/shipping/[rpc].ts) > root catch-all (...notfound.ts)
rejected: API gateway configuration file (separate route table to maintain, drift between routes and handlers)
Central router script (single point of change for all routes, poor team scalability)
design_space.why_chosen: Filesystem routing makes the API surface self-documenting — the directory tree IS the route table. Adding an endpoint means adding a file, not editing a config. Precedence rules are implicit in the filesystem structure, eliminating route conflict misconfigurations.
design_space.why_rejected: Filesystem routing makes the API surface self-documenting — the directory tree IS the route table. Adding an endpoint means adding a file, not editing a config. Precedence rules are implicit in the filesystem structure, eliminating route conflict misconfigurations.
evidence: api/[...notfound].ts: 'As a root-level catch-all ([...slug]) this has the LOWEST dynamic-route precedence, so concrete functions (api/health.ts) and nested dynamic gateways (api/<service>/v1/[rpc].ts, api/v2/shipping/[rpc].ts) always resolve FIRST'

design_space.decision: Multi-tier caching (CDN + Redis + Bootstrap) over single cache layer
design_space.chosen: Three-tier cache with distinct TTL policies: CDN edge for global low-latency delivery, Redis for server-side shared state with freshness-based TTL, in-browser bootstrap cache for instant subsequent page loads
rejected: Single CDN cache only (no server-side coordination, stale data served until TTL expiry)
Single Redis cache (central bottleneck, no edge distribution, higher latency for global users)
No cache (unacceptable latency for global intelligence dashboard)
design_space.why_chosen: Each tier optimizes for a different latency/capacity trade-off: CDN eliminates network round-trips for static/popular data, Redis provides sub-millisecond server-side lookups, bootstrap cache eliminates HTTP round-trips entirely for repeat visits. Coordinated invalidation ensures freshness without sacrificing performance.
design_space.why_rejected: Each tier optimizes for a different latency/capacity trade-off: CDN eliminates network round-trips for static/popular data, Redis provides sub-millisecond server-side lookups, bootstrap cache eliminates HTTP round-trips entirely for repeat visits. Coordinated invalidation ensures freshness without sacrificing performance.
evidence: Repository Model: Caching Layer — 'Multi-tier cache orchestration spanning CDN edge cache, Redis cluster, and in-browser bootstrap cache with invalidation protocols'
Repository Model: behavior.data_flow: '外部数据源 → 聚合管道 → Redis 缓存 → CDN 边缘缓存 → SPA 前端 bootstrap cache → 浏览器渲染'

design_space.decision: Automated architecture enforcement via lint scripts over convention-based governance
design_space.chosen: 8+ standalone enforce scripts running in CI (module boundary lint, API contract enforcement, rate limit policy audit, premium fetch gating, safe HTML validation, documentation slug checks)
rejected: Convention-only governance (unenforceable, relies on code review catch, inconsistent)
Single monolithic linter rule set (hard to understand failure reasons, difficult to add domain-specific rules individually)
Runtime enforcement only (catches violations in production, too late)
design_space.why_chosen: Architecture governance as automated CI gates — violations fail the build before merge. Each enforce script is independently maintainable and provides targeted error messages. The script-per-rule pattern allows domain experts (security, API design, docs) to own specific enforcement rules.
design_space.why_rejected: Architecture governance as automated CI gates — violations fail the build before merge. Each enforce script is independently maintainable and provides targeted error messages. The script-per-rule pattern allows domain experts (security, API design, docs) to own specific enforcement rules.

design_space.decision: A2A protocol + custom concierge over existing agent frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel)
design_space.chosen: Custom lightweight token-overlap concierge implementing Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol with RFC 9728/8414 discovery documents; tool registry with anonymous tools/list publication
rejected: LangChain integration (heavy dependency tree, excess abstraction for deterministic routing)
Semantic Kernel (Microsoft-centric ecosystem, .NET heritage conflicting with edge-first TypeScript)
Build own from scratch without standards (no interoperability)
design_space.why_chosen: A2A is an emerging open standard for agent-to-agent communication; implementing it directly ensures interoperability with any A2A-compliant agent. The lightweight concierge (no NLU, no vector DB) stays within edge function constraints. RFC 9728/8414 compliance makes the system discoverable by standard OAuth-aware agents.
design_space.why_rejected: A2A is an emerging open standard for agent-to-agent communication; implementing it directly ensures interoperability with any A2A-compliant agent. The lightweight concierge (no NLU, no vector DB) stays within edge function constraints. RFC 9728/8414 compliance makes the system discoverable by standard OAuth-aware agents.

design_space.decision: Desktop Tauri support via origin allowlisting rather than a separate auth system
design_space.chosen: Tauri desktop origins (tauri.localhost, tauri://, asset://localhost) are allowlisted in the API key validation middleware; desktop uses the same API key/session token auth model as the web SPA
rejected: Separate desktop authentication system (duplicate auth infrastructure, different security model, maintenance burden)
Desktop-only API endpoints (fragmentation of API surface, inconsistent behavior)
No desktop support (misses native OS integration for intelligence dashboard)
design_space.why_chosen: Reusing the web auth model for desktop keeps the security surface consistent — a valid API key or session token works identically from browser or desktop. Origin allowlisting prevents unauthorized origins from claiming desktop privileges. The pattern allows the desktop to be treated as 'another browser context' with the same server-side trust model.
design_space.why_rejected: Reusing the web auth model for desktop keeps the security surface consistent — a valid API key or session token works identically from browser or desktop. Origin allowlisting prevents unauthorized origins from claiming desktop privileges. The pattern allows the desktop to be treated as 'another browser context' with the same server-side trust model.
evidence: api/_api-key.js: DESKTOP_ORIGIN_PATTERNS array with tauri.localhost, tauri://localhost, asset://localhost patterns
Repository Model: evolution.major_changes: 'Tauri Desktop Runtime 支持 — 扩展到桌面原生应用，通过 tauri.localhost / tauri:// origins 与 web API 共享认证和安全模型'
